subject: [PATCH 02/60] mm: publish and clear node memory states via helpers

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch series centralizes the updates of node memory states by introducing two new helpers, `node_set_memory_state` and `node_clear_memory_state`. These functions are used to publish and clear the memory states of a node, respectively. The goal is to simplify the code and make it easier to manage node memory states.
